business.name: Northgate Heating & Air
business.hours: Mon–Fri 7am–6pm. No-heat calls answered 24/7 from October to April.

hero.headline: Furnace repair in Saskatoon, priced before we start
hero.subhead: Most no-heat calls get a tech the same day. You hear the price before any work begins, and that is the price you pay.

fear.fear: Paying more than you were told
fear.answer: Flat-rate pricing, quoted before we pick up a tool. What we quote is what you pay.
fear.proof: The quote is written on the work order you sign before we start.

services.name: Furnace repair
services.summary: No heat, short cycling or strange noises, diagnosed and fixed, usually in one visit.
services.whenNeeded: Your furnace won't start, keeps shutting off, or the house won't get warm.
services.differentiator: The trucks carry the common parts for the brands we see most, so most repairs finish on the first visit.

services.name: Furnace installation
services.summary: A new high-efficiency furnace sized to your house, with the old one hauled away.
services.whenNeeded: Your furnace is past 15 years old, repairs keep adding up, or you're finishing a basement.
services.differentiator: We do a heat-loss calculation before quoting, so the furnace fits the house instead of the brochure.

services.name: Air conditioning
services.summary: AC tune-ups, repairs and new installs before the first hot week.
services.whenNeeded: The AC blows warm, freezes up, or hasn't been serviced in two summers.
services.differentiator: Spring tune-ups are booked by street, so the visit window is two hours, not a whole day.

services.name: Maintenance plan
services.summary: One furnace and one AC check a year, with priority booking when something breaks.
services.whenNeeded: You'd rather not find out the furnace is failing on the coldest night of the year.
services.differentiator: Plan members get booked ahead of the queue on no-heat calls.

reviews.text: Furnace quit on a Sunday night. They had someone here Monday morning and told me the price before he started.

reviews.text: Quoted a new furnace with an actual heat-loss calculation. The other two quotes just guessed.
